decisions.reason: As an established trommel screen that was essentially a renamed, already accepted machine, it now carries both prior market proof and accumulated commitment, so management would be very reluctant to withdraw it.

This multi-model mobile shredder line represents substantial development effort and visible public commitment in a core mobile-processing segment, which under escalation of commitment strongly favors continuation.

Although less prominently launched than some other lines, this mobile grinder family still reflects meaningful investment and fits the firm's mobile recycling portfolio, so management would likely keep backing it and view any weakness as temporary.

The stationary electric fine shredder has the weakest visible commitment among these products, but it still supports the firm's resource-saving and tougher-processing direction, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.
A dedicated page and several models in stationary pre-shredding signal high sunk costs and strategic intent, so management would tend to persist with the line rather than reverse course.
